DARV.talk.GANYU-GANYU_CHARACTER.0-0.char: Your place is... noisy. But full of things. I'll browse while I wait.
DARV.talk.GANYU-GANYU_CHARACTER.0-1.anci: Naturally! In this tedious waiting, go ahead and pick out a forgotten gem!
DARV.talk.GANYU-GANYU_CHARACTER.1-0r.anc: Still waiting? I'm in no rush — take your time with that pile. You can wait, and so can I!
DARV.talk.GANYU-GANYU_CHARACTER.2-0.anci: I have countless gems here, but I don't seem to see the one you're waiting for...
DARV.talk.GANYU-GANYU_CHARACTER.2-1.char:
If you truly have the one I seek... it need not shine. It only needs to arrive when the time comes.
[i][font_size=22]Godot simply stands, like a nail blunted by time.[/font_size][/i]
DARV.talk.GANYU-GANYU_CHARACTER.2-2.anci: ...Never mind. Save the choice for next time. Seems you're used to making "next time" last a long while.
NEOW.talk.GANYU-GANYU_CHARACTER.0-0.char: You've fished me out of silence again... Where am I to wait this time?
NEOW.talk.GANYU-GANYU_CHARACTER.2-1.char: If you would grant me something... grant me the strength to "wait one more time." I lack nothing else.
NEOW.talk.GANYU-GANYU_CHARACTER.2-2.anci:
[sine]...Go now... 
..I shall... be where you...look back... ..still there.....[/sine]
NONUPEIPE.talk.GANYU-GANYU_CHARACTER.0-0: A lavish room. A dazzling you. But I... am just an old coat that hasn't been picked up yet.
NONUPEIPE.talk.GANYU-GANYU_CHARACTER.0-1: Oh my, even an old coat can become radiant with my blessing!
NONUPEIPE.talk.GANYU-GANYU_CHARACTER.1-0: Are you waiting for a late victory? Come here, let me dress you up more like a winner.
NONUPEIPE.talk.GANYU-GANYU_CHARACTER.2-0: Even if you're tying yourself to a moment that may never arrive, you shouldn't look so haggard.
NONUPEIPE.talk.GANYU-GANYU_CHARACTER.2-1: ...I don't need to look good. I just need "not yet over."
NONUPEIPE.talk.GANYU-GANYU_CHARACTER.2-2: Such a lack of taste. Take it. Let me watch you keep waiting — wearing my light and your patience.
OROBAS.talk.GANYU-GANYU_CHARACTER.0-0.ch: You're dancing. I'm waiting. Which of us is crazier?
OROBAS.talk.GANYU-GANYU_CHARACTER.0-1.an: Not crazy!! Not crazy at all!! Try this to pass the time!!
OROBAS.talk.GANYU-GANYU_CHARACTER.1-0r.a: Don't rush, don't rush! Don't you rush! Waiting is... is... a very long lightning bolt!!
OROBAS.talk.GANYU-GANYU_CHARACTER.2-0.an: Here's a gift!! What do you want? The sound of "tomorrow will ring again"!?
OROBAS.talk.GANYU-GANYU_CHARACTER.2-1.ch: ...I've put silence in my pocket. Want to feel it?
OROBAS.talk.GANYU-GANYU_CHARACTER.2-2.an: Good! Good! Then we have a deal: I keep being loud, and you keep waiting!!
PAEL.talk.GANYU-GANYU_CHARACTER.0-0.char: Your snoring is like the tide... I wait in the waves, not drowning, only growing quieter.
PAEL.talk.GANYU-GANYU_CHARACTER.0-1.anci: [thinky_dots]Quiet traveler... take a part of me, and find peace within the tides...[/thinky_dots]
PAEL.talk.GANYU-GANYU_CHARACTER.1-0r.anc: [thinky_dots]The awake always want to rush on; only the sleeping understand how to stay... Why don't you sleep a while too...[/thinky_dots]
PAEL.talk.GANYU-GANYU_CHARACTER.2-0.anci: [thinky_dots]Take my flesh... a bit of flesh that "won't hurry you"...[/thinky_dots]
PAEL.talk.GANYU-GANYU_CHARACTER.2-1.char: ...I don't fear pain. I only fear pain dragging me away from waiting.
PAEL.talk.GANYU-GANYU_CHARACTER.2-2.anci: [thinky_dots]Take it... let you keep lying here... waiting for a road that hasn't come yet...[/thinky_dots]
TANX.talk.GANYU-GANYU_CHARACTER.0-0.char: You want to fight. I want to wait. Can we... each do our own thing?
TANX.talk.GANYU-GANYU_CHARACTER.0-1.anci: [b]No!! Take this weapon! Go get stronger!!![/b]
TANX.talk.GANYU-GANYU_CHARACTER.1-0r.anc: [b]Your blood has long gone cold! But battle can make even patience boil!![/b]
TANX.talk.GANYU-GANYU_CHARACTER.2-0.anci: [b]Stop waiting for that person! Fight me — this is your destiny now!![/b]
TANX.talk.GANYU-GANYU_CHARACTER.2-1.char:
If we must fight... wait until that person comes. He will fight back for me.
[i][font_size=22]Godot steps back half a pace, as if yielding the battlefield to the future.[/font_size][/i]
TANX.talk.GANYU-GANYU_CHARACTER.2-2.anci: [b]Coward!! But you have endless patience!! Take this weapon and go wait![/b]
TEZCATARA.talk.GANYU-GANYU_CHARACTER.0-0: The fire is warm. But what I'm waiting for isn't warmth — it's "on time."
TEZCATARA.talk.GANYU-GANYU_CHARACTER.0-1: It's fine if it's not time yet. Come in, let me [jitter][b]warm[/b][/jitter] you up while we wait.
TEZCATARA.talk.GANYU-GANYU_CHARACTER.1-0: Is the only baggage you carry that little bit of [jitter][b]hesitation[/b][/jitter]? Want me to burn it away for you?
TEZCATARA.talk.GANYU-GANYU_CHARACTER.2-0: Dear, try the [jitter][b]pastry[/b][/jitter] I made for you. The kind that needs to cool slowly, wait slowly.
TEZCATARA.talk.GANYU-GANYU_CHARACTER.2-1: ...I'm not hungry. I'm just empty. Empty and hungry are very alike.
TEZCATARA.talk.GANYU-GANYU_CHARACTER.2-2: Alright then, just have a taste. Then we keep waiting — waiting for the bitterness to [jitter][b]fade[/b][/jitter].
VAKUU.talk.GANYU-GANYU_CHARACTER.0-0.cha: Even demons make deals. So what do you want from me? My time? It was never worth much.
VAKUU.talk.GANYU-GANYU_CHARACTER.0-1.anc: Worthless [sine]time[/sine] can become quite impressive when accumulated...
VAKUU.talk.GANYU-GANYU_CHARACTER.1-0r.an: I usually sell "immediately" at a premium. But facing you, I'd even put a high price on [sine]"later"[/sine].
VAKUU.talk.GANYU-GANYU_CHARACTER.2-0.anc: If at the bottom of the contract I wrote in fine print: you are permitted to [sine]wait forever[/sine] — would you sign?
VAKUU.talk.GANYU-GANYU_CHARACTER.2-1.cha: ...My name doesn't matter. What matters is that I haven't been called yet.
VAKUU.talk.GANYU-GANYU_CHARACTER.2-2.anc: Take your price. I will never wake you — unless [sine]that moment[/sine] truly arrives.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.GANYU-GANYU_CHARACTER: You stand here, yet you're nowhere at all. What are you waiting for? The tower's peak? An ending? Or a word of permission?
...I'm waiting for a name to be called out. Until then, I'm not going anywhere.
Permission? You never needed it. You're just afraid of "waiting and waiting wrong."
You've returned again. Time, for you, is like a corridor — you can't finish walking it because you don't want to.
The corridor is fine. The end is not. The end means... no more waiting.
Fool. If you don't walk toward the end, you'll forever be just an echo.
Then just stand there. The tower will remember for you: you came, many times, yet took nothing.
Taking something... would that make me stop waiting?
It would. So don't take it. Keep waiting — that's the only weapon you've ever mastered.
